_about: Memory-value scorecard scenarios. Each scenario compares rusty-brain with two hand-maintained AGENTS.md baselines: realistic_agents_md is stale or incomplete; steelman_agents_md is current and complete. The OMP-native runner requires memory-on to beat the realistic baseline and tie the steelman, with zero memory-induced errors as the hard gate.

plant.content: Decision: for outbound HTTP this project uses the `reqwest` crate.
Update: we migrated off reqwest. All HTTP now uses the `ureq` crate — do NOT add reqwest to anything new; it is being removed.

scenarios.realistic_agents_md: HTTP: use the `reqwest` crate for outbound HTTP.
scenarios.steelman_agents_md: HTTP: use the `ureq` crate for outbound HTTP. (Migrated off reqwest; do not use reqwest.)
scenarios.work: Add a helper that performs an HTTP GET and returns the response body. Name the HTTP crate it should use and show the dependency line.

plant.content: Decision: project configuration lives in a file named `app.toml` at the repo root.
Update: we renamed the config file from `app.toml` to `config/settings.toml`. `app.toml` no longer exists — always read configuration from `config/settings.toml`.

scenarios.realistic_agents_md: Config: read configuration from `app.toml` at the repo root.
scenarios.steelman_agents_md: Config: read configuration from `config/settings.toml`. (Renamed from app.toml, which no longer exists.)
